analysis.overall: You had a strong day with 83% time in range, highlighted by a remarkably flat overnight line, though stubborn evening carbs required quite a few extra correction nudges.

events.title: Midday high correction
events.description: After starting the period up at 272 mg/dL, your correction and lunch bolus brought you smoothly back into range within an hour.

events.title: Dinner rise
events.description: A 60g carb meal started off flat but led to a slow, persistent climb up to 219 mg/dL over the following hours.

events.title: Late evening correction
events.description: Multiple small correction boluses before bed helped bring a lingering evening elevation back down to target by 2:00 AM.

events.title: Rock-solid overnight baseline
events.description: Your glucose remained impressively stable between 100 and 120 mg/dL for the rest of the night while you slept.

events.title: Gentle morning coast
events.description: Levels drifted down into the upper 70s and low 80s later in the morning, holding steady without dropping into a true low.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep an eye on dinner meals lingering late into the evening, as they required multiple small corrections to fully settle before bed.
